(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-frame? obj)
      (and (= (obj-color obj) 1)
           (>= (obj-h obj) 3)
           (>= (obj-w obj) 3)
           (= (obj-size obj) (- (* (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj))
                                (* (- (obj-h obj) 2) (- (obj-w obj) 2))))
           (all? (lambda (p)
                   (or (= (first p) (obj-r1 obj))
                       (= (first p) (obj-r2 obj))
                       (= (second p) (obj-c1 obj))
                       (= (second p) (obj-c2 obj))))
                 (obj-cells obj))))
    (define (binary-crop grid)
      (let* ((cells (filter-cells grid (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0)))))
             (bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
             (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb))
             (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb)))
        (grid-from-fn (+ 1 (- r1 r0)) (+ 1 (- c1 c0))
          (lambda (r c)
            (if (member? (list (+ r0 r) (+ c0 c)) cells) 1 0)))))
    (define (symmetry-class grid)
      (let ((h? (equal? grid (flip-lr grid)))
            (v? (equal? grid (flip-ud grid))))
        (cond [(and h? v?) 3]
              [(not (eq? h? #f)) 1]
              [(not (eq? v? #f)) 2]
              [else 0])))
    (define frames
      (sort (filter rect-frame? (objects g 0))
            (lambda (a b)
              (if (= (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))
                  (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                  (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))))))
    (define classes
      (map (lambda (frame)
             (symmetry-class
               (binary-crop
                 (subgrid g (+ (obj-r1 frame) 1) (+ (obj-c1 frame) 1)
                          (- (obj-r2 frame) 1) (- (obj-c2 frame) 1)))))
           frames))
    (define n (length classes))
    (grid-from-fn n n
      (lambda (r c) (if (= (list-ref classes r) (list-ref classes c)) 2 0)))))
